text:
Silver Price in 1999
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1999, the LBMA silver price rose 1.8% between 1999-01-29 ($5.24) and 1999-12-30 ($5.33). The highest sampled price was $5.58 in February and the lowest was $4.94 in May. The mean of these observations was $5.28. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
